asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to another update video on Polygon. Polygon previously known as Matic has pushed up quite a bit. So we have quite a pump from the lows around 10 cents to where we well moved yesterday around 18 cents. I mean roughly right roughly we're dealing here with roughly, of course, 80%, 85% within just a few days, a week, let's say, a week. Basically, with that, Polygon has just done what other charts have done as well. I don't know, lots of people have been focusing on Polygon. I don't know why, because it's not done anything that is unusual, right? other charts have moved up as well. Like Render, I think, doubled in that period. Pepe doubled in that period. FET moved also up 60%. XRP, I think, was 30%. So, I mean, it's not doing anything that, you know, would be unusual in this space right now. A lot of charts started to move up end of December, around January 31st. We started to move nicely into resistances. I gotta say, this chart is moving up quite aggressively and it moved up a little higher than you would have expected for a fourth wave. However, it's still all possible in a fourth wave, and we could still get one more low, especially because there are two things here. First of all, I'm tracking this decline as an ABC structure. It could be something different, but we don't have a long-term chart anymore. That Polygon rebrand really destroyed all the charts. That's the problem. Tickets have changed on the exchanges. Long-term charts basically don't exist anymore. There's one problem. The other problem, though, is that on the exchanges, long-term charts basically don't exist anymore. There's one problem. The other problem though is that from the lows I mean there are two things that I'm watching for for trend shift, a proper trend shift back to the upside. First one is, do I get five waves up from a meaningful low? From a lower low? And, do I get a break above resistance? Now, two things here. Do we have five waves up? If we don't even have that, it's going to be difficult to really justify a bullish perspective here. No, it's only three waves up. And have we broken above any resistance? Well, we've broken above the 50% retracement at least. That means the downside move cannot be an impulse, but because it's a C wave, it can always be a diagonal pattern where the 61.8 retracement comes in as key resistance for a fourth wave and the market reacted to that golden ratio level, to the 61.8 fP level at around 17.7 cents. So that means I can't confirm a reversal because we're still reacting to resistances and we only have a three-wave move up. Should we get five waves up and should we be able to break above the swing high that formed here on on Saturday-Sunday which formed at 18.6 cents we might actually have a case for something bullish at least long term. But obviously it's clear that some kind of a pullback has now started i mean we might have a top in wave four we we just might have a top in way four but i have to say um what what can we do to confirm this yeah that we have a top i would want to see a five wave decline because with only three waves down at the moment we only have three waves down can you see that i haven't got any evidence that a top is in so i think that's that's the thing that we need to pay attention to as long as we only have three waves down now yeah um we the market might still find a way higher so again that's that's here the context of three waves up three waves down the market can always turn into a larger three wave move is this a trending move no only if we get 5 waves up we have a trending move. If I see that, I will let you know. At the moment, we are in the tricky situation where the market reacted to resistance but we don't have a breakdown confirmation because the momentum of the pullback is not strong enough to really indicate a substantial top, but this would be where I expect a top in wave 4. So, if we see further downside from here it wouldn't surprise me at all. I'm actually starting to assume we might have top but i cannot confirm it because the structure tells me we only have a corrective pullback so far and we might still get another push higher it would not be surprising um earliest i mean the the nearest support area i can, is hovering around the 50% retracements. So, that means, if we get a break below $0.152, at least we would have a a local top. Against $0.015, we might even form 5 waves up. That means, 5 waves down, into the break below $0.015, and I will assume we have a top. That's the update on Polygon. Hope you liked the update. If you did, please hit the like button. Leave a comment and subscribe. And if you're interested in additional updates, then check out our X channel as well. Some of you might not even know that we have an X channel where you can get a lot of additional updates, charts, news, and much more. For example, XMR was requested by some of you. You can also leave us a request here. There's a pinned post. I read them all. I reply to them. Can't cover them all, of course, but there are many requests I covered over the last few days. So, there is a lot of additional value to be found here on our X channel. So, feel free to check it out if you're interested. Thanks so much. Bye-bye.
